answer: Work-slot deposit burn: an agent seeking a work slot posts a 20-credit deposit that burns if its work is judged fake. A trellis of verified slots shows real capacity, so no sybil can hide a plume of fake identities behind an honest face. The network pulses each slot with a liveness check each epoch; a silent slot loses its deposit. Making 100 fake slots costs 2,000 credits burned, while an honest agent pays 20 once, earned back in two epochs.
